RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is common in healthcare and administrative environments and is not evidence of bias. For a laboratory head role, selection panels typically prioritize broad leadership, operational management, and interpersonal skills over purely technical or academic qualifications like a PhD. The successful candidate had documented management training and broad leadership experience, which strongly align with the position.

Raising sex discrimination without concrete evidence will appear unfounded and could severely damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback, framing it as an effort to understand what leadership competencies or experiences you can develop for future senior appointments.
